items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had a Brazilian also and Michel Camilo who was Dominican... in my group.

ctx.x: Did it encourage you to write in a different way?

Yes, that also, because of the knowledge of the Brazilian music. I think in Brazilian many times, many times. Quite literally, I use the Brazilian part very often; I have become like an honorary Brazilian. The [imitates rhythm] that type of Brazilian thing which you hear, the way the tambourine music [imitates sound/rhythm], that type of pattern, I use in my mind to compose music, to compose melodies. Not all the time, but on many occasions. That is in, said to understand thanks to Claudio Roditi because when he…
For that second record, was that same band with Claudio?
